name: benchlab-text2video-energy-benchmark
description: A benchmark that measures the energy consumption and efficiency of text-to-video generation models under realistic workloads. It records metrics such as power draw, total energy use, and estimated carbon emissions across different hardware and model settings to compare environmental cost. The dataset and scripts enable repeatable measurement of throughput vs. energy trade-offs for text-to-video systems.
general_score_metric: energy_consumption (kWh) per generated minute / CO2-equivalent emissions
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and used by a niche set of researchers and practitioners focused on model efficiency and environmental impact; adoption is growing but not yet widespread.
